name: Doxycycline
summary: A versatile tetracycline used heavily in acne, atypical infections, and tick-borne disease because it is orally convenient and broad enough to matter.
good: Acne or atypical/tick-borne infections where doxycycline is a standard choice.
bad: Pregnancy, young children, or anyone who cannot follow the absorption rules.
clinicalPearls: Take it with water and do not lie down right after dosing.
mechanism: Binds the 30S ribosomal subunit and blocks aminoacyl-tRNA attachment.
indications: Acne, atypical respiratory infections, chlamydia, Lyme disease, and several rickettsial infections.
interactionNotes: Iron, calcium, magnesium, and antacids reduce absorption; avoid combination with isotretinoin because of intracranial hypertension risk.

warnings: Photosensitivity, esophagitis, pregnancy/children under 8, and GI upset are central warnings.
